settings.title: Settings
backups.download.heading: Download a backup
backups.download.body: One zip file with everything on your site: its pages and posts, settings, photos and files. Keep it somewhere safe, away from this server. To move your site, choose Start from a backup when you set up the new one.
backups.download.private: Keep this file private. It holds everyone's sign-in details too, so anyone who has it can make a copy of your site.
backups.download.ownerOnly: Only the Owner can download a backup, because it holds everyone's sign-in details.
backups.download.never: No backup has been downloaded yet.
backups.disk.heading: Space on this server
backups.disk.low: Space is running low. Remove photos and files you no longer need from Media, or ask your host for more.
backups.disk.veryLow: Space has nearly run out, and when it does your changes can't be saved. Remove photos and files you no longer need from Media, or ask your host for more.
backups.copies.heading: Copies kept on this server
backups.copies.body: Each day at 3 in the morning, Tend saves a copy of your pages, posts and settings here, and it saves one before each update too. It keeps a week of daily copies and four weekly ones, in no more than a fifth of the disk. Photos and files aren't in these copies: a downloaded backup has everything. Keep a downloaded copy private too, because it holds everyone's sign-in details. Anything you delete from Media stays on this server for up to six weeks, so these copies can still show it, or less if space runs low.
backups.copies.none: There are no copies yet. Tend saves the first within a day.
backups.restore.heading: Put the site back as it was
backups.restore.body: Restore a backup you downloaded, or choose Restore beside one of the copies above. Everything goes back to how it was then, everyone's accounts too. Tend saves a copy of the site as it is now first, so you can come back to it.
backups.restore.fileHint: It's the .zip file from Download backup.
backups.restore.notABackup: That isn't a Tend backup. Choose the .zip file you downloaded from Settings → Backups.

backups.restore.signedOut: Everyone is signed out, and signs in again with the password they had then. That includes you.
backups.restore.undo: The site as it is now is saved first. To go back to it, restore the copy called Before a restore.
backups.restore.keep: Keep the site as it is

online.title: Put your site online
online.intro: Your site is on this computer, so only you can see it. To show it to everyone, it needs a server that's always on. Here's a way that needs no commands. Once you have a Railway account, it takes about ten minutes.
online.introElsewhere: Here's how to move your site to Railway, with everything in it. Once you have a Railway account, it takes about ten minutes.
online.backupBody: One file with your whole site: its pages, photos, settings and sign-ins. Keep it private.
online.railway: Put a new Tend on Railway
online.railwayBody: Railway is a service that runs it for you. It asks for one thing: a setup password, which you make up. Write it down, because you'll type it once in the next step.
online.railwayCost: It needs Railway's Hobby plan, which is $5 a month with $5 of usage included, and a card. Railway lets you set a usage limit, so that it can't cost more than you expect. Its free plans would stop your site.
online.start: Choose Start from a backup there
online.startBody: When Railway says it's ready, open the address it gives you and type your setup password. Choose Start from a backup, and then the file from step 1.
online.address: Sign in, and use the new address
online.addressBody: Your email and password are the same. Overview there asks about the address: choose {button}. Then your site is live.
online.after: From then on, make your changes there. The copy on this computer stays as it is, and nothing you change in one reaches the other.
online.ownServer: On a server of your own
domain.title: Connect your domain
domain.localFirst: Your site has to be online before it can have a domain of its own.
domain.intro: With a domain of your own, people find your site at a name like www.risebakery.com. Most of this happens where you bought the domain, and at your host.
domain.hostBody.railway: Open this site's service there, then Settings, Networking, Custom domain. Type the domain with www in front, such as www.risebakery.com. Railway shows you two records, a CNAME and a TXT. Both are needed.
domain.host.other: Tell your host about the domain
domain.hostBody.other: Add it in your host's settings for this site. On a server of your own with Docker, put it in the .env file as TEND_DOMAIN, then run docker compose up -d.
domain.records: Add the records where you bought it
domain.recordsBody.railway: Find DNS in your domain company's settings, and add both records exactly as Railway shows them.
domain.recordsBody.other: Find DNS in your domain company's settings. Add the record your host shows you, or for a server of your own an A record with the server's IP address.
domain.www: Use the name with www as your main address. Many domain companies can't point the bare name, such as risebakery.com, at a host, but they can forward it to the one with www.
domain.waitBody: It usually works within the hour, and can take a day. Your host gets the certificate for https by itself.
domain.useBody: Open the admin there, at its name followed by /admin/. Sign in, and Overview asks whether to use the new address. You can also choose it here, once you're on this page at the new address.
domain.email: If you're asked to move your domain's nameservers, copy its MX and TXT records across first, or email to your domain stops arriving.
domain.guide: The full guide, company by company
help.title: Help
help.intro: Short answers to what people ask most.
help.writeBody: Choose New post in Posts. Type a title, press Enter and write. Type / on an empty line to add a heading, a picture or a button. What you write is saved as you go, and nobody else sees it until you choose Publish post.
help.changeBody: Open it in Pages and type. Your changes are saved as you go. Visitors keep seeing the page as it was until you choose Publish changes, and Discard changes takes you back to what they see.
help.picturesBody: Drag it into what you're writing, paste it, or type / and choose Image. Then say what's in it, for people who can't see it. The same picture can be used again from Media.
help.undoBody: Undo is at the top of the editor, and after most changes there's an Undo for a few seconds. For a page as it was last week, open it and choose History. Anything moved to the Trash can be restored for 30 days.
help.menu: Put a page in the menu
help.menuBody: Tick Show in site menu when you publish it, or add a link to it in Site menu, where you can also change the order.
help.lookBody: Design has the logo, colours, fonts and header. Preview shows your site with the changes before you save them, and Undo takes a saved one back.
help.peopleBody: In People, type their email and choose Make an invite link, then send it to them. It works once, for a week. Editors write and publish everything, and Admins can change settings and the design too.
help.backup: Keep a copy of the site
help.backupBody: Tend saves a copy each day where it runs. Now and then, download a backup as well, and keep it somewhere else: it has everything, photos included.
help.online: Put the site online, or give it a domain
help.onlineBody: Overview has the next step for your site, with a guide.
help.lockedBody: Choose Forgot password where you sign in. The quickest way is a code from your recovery kit, so keep a copy of it. The Owner can send anyone a link to choose a new password.
help.askAdmin: If something isn't working, ask whoever runs this site.

code.warning: For things like a site check, or a way of counting visitors that isn't in Visitor stats. Only paste code from a company you trust: it can do anything on your site. It's left out of previews.
stats.heading: Count your visitors
stats.body: Choose a service that counts visitors without cookies, so your site doesn't need a banner asking about them. Sign up with it, add your site there, then paste below what it gives you. Previews aren't counted.
stats.idHint.plausible: As you added it to Plausible, like rise-bakery.com. Or paste the whole snippet Plausible gave you, if it has data-domain in it.
stats.idHint.fathom: From your site's settings in Fathom, like ABCDEFGH. Or paste the whole embed code.
stats.idHint.umami: From the website's settings in Umami, under Tracking code. Or paste the whole tracking code.
stats.idHint.cloudflare: From Manage site in Cloudflare's Web Analytics: the 32 letters and numbers after "token" in the snippet. Or paste the whole snippet.
stats.scriptHint: Only for Umami on a server of your own, like https://stats.rise-bakery.com/script.js. Leave it empty for Umami Cloud.
stats.noGoogle: Google Analytics isn't here, because it uses cookies: your site would need a banner asking every visitor first.
code.head: In the head of every page
code.bodyEnd: At the end of every page
editor.contactDetails: Your business details show here: address, phone, email, a map link and opening hours. They're the same everywhere on your site.
editor.contactEdit: Change the business details (opens in a new tab)
overview.backup.heading: Download a backup
overview.backup.never: You haven't downloaded a backup of your site yet. Keep one somewhere safe, away from this server.
overview.backup.since: You last downloaded a backup on {date}. Download a new one, so it has everything you've added since.
editor.takenOffMenu: Taken off your site, and out of the site menu. It's a draft now.
editor.uploadLeftBehind: {count, plural, one {{names} was still uploading when you left, so it isn't in what you were writing. It'll be in Media when it finishes: add it from there.} other {{names} were still uploading when you left, so they aren't in what you were writing. They'll be in Media when they finish: add them from there.}}
editor.uploadFailedLeft: {count, plural, one {{names} wasn't uploaded, so it isn't in what you were writing. Add it again.} other {{names} weren't uploaded, so they aren't in what you were writing. Add them again.}}
editor.picturesFailed: {count, plural, one {1 picture wasn't uploaded} other {# pictures weren't uploaded}}
check.uploading: {count, plural, one {1 picture is still uploading, so it won't be on your site yet. Wait for it to finish, then publish.} other {# pictures are still uploading, so they won't be on your site yet. Wait for them to finish, then publish.}}
check.uploadFailed: {count, plural, one {1 picture wasn't uploaded, so it won't be on your site. Try it again, or remove it.} other {# pictures weren't uploaded, so they won't be on your site. Try them again, or remove them.}}
settings.nothingChanged: Nothing changed: that's how it was already.
tags.cantLoad: Can't load your tags right now, so their names may be missing. Check your connection, then reload the page.
design.pictureGone: That picture was deleted. Choose another, or remove it.
account.title: Your account
account.name: Your name
account.nameHint: Shown to the other people on this site.
account.emailChanged: Your email is changed. Sign in with the new one from now on.
account.passwordAbout: You stay signed in here. Every other device is signed out.
account.passwordChanged: Your password is changed, and your other devices are signed out.
account.devicesAbout: If you've left yourself signed in somewhere, sign out on every device, this one included.
kit.heading: Recovery kit
kit.saveIt: If you ever can't sign in, one of these codes gets you back in, with no email needed. Each works once. Save them now, somewhere safe: Tend can't show them again.
kit.left: {left, plural, one {You have # recovery code left} other {You have # recovery codes left}}, from a kit made on {date}.
kit.leftUnsaved: {left, plural, one {You have # recovery code left} other {You have # recovery codes left}}, from a kit made on {date}, but Tend can't tell that you kept a copy. If you didn't, make a new kit.
kit.none: You don't have any recovery codes. Make a kit, so you can still get in if you forget your password.
kit.about: A new kit has eight new codes, and the codes in your old one stop working.
kit.passwordHint: Needed to make a new kit.
people.title: People
people.intro: Everyone who can sign in to this site, and what they can do.
people.roleHint.admin: Can do everything, except download backups and change other Admins.
people.roleHint.editor: Writes and publishes posts and pages, adds photos, and edits the menu.
people.roleHint.writer: Writes their own posts, and asks for them to be published.
people.resetMade: Send this link to {name}, by message or however suits. It lets them choose a new password, works once, and runs out in a day.
people.roleChanged: {name} is now {role, select, admin {an Admin} editor {an Editor} other {a Writer}}, and needs to sign in again.
people.handOverBody: They become the Owner, who alone can download backups and change Admins. You stay as an Admin, and only they can hand it back.
people.confirmRemoveBody: They're signed out at once and can't sign in again. What they wrote stays on the site.
people.inviteMade: Send this link to {email}, by email or message. It works once, for 7 days.
people.copyByHand: Your browser didn't let Tend copy it. Select the link and copy it yourself.
link.title: This link can't be used
link.incomplete: Not all of this link arrived. Open it again from the message it came in.
invite.title: Join {site}
invite.from: {name} invited you to {site} as {role, select, admin {an Admin} editor {an Editor} other {a Writer}}.
invite.fromNoName: You're invited to {site} as {role, select, admin {an Admin} editor {an Editor} other {a Writer}}.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.codesLeft: That code is used up now. {left, plural, =0 {It was your last one, so make a new kit in Account once you're in.} one {You have # left.} other {You have # left.}}
reset.done: Your new password is saved. Anywhere else you were signed in, you're signed out.
recover.title: Use a recovery code
recover.intro: Type the email you sign in with and one of the codes from your recovery kit. Then you'll choose a new password.
recover.codeHint: It looks like ABCDE-12345. Each code works once.
recover.codeRequired: Type one of your recovery codes.
forgot.codeHint: From the recovery kit you saved when you set up your account.
forgot.someoneHint: The Owner can send anyone a link to choose a new password, from People. Admins can for Editors.
forgot.npm: In your site's folder, if it was made with npm:
forgot.docker: On the server, if it's in Docker:
forgot.developerHint: They can run this where Tend is running, with your email. It shows a new password and signs you out everywhere.
